baseline_models.mechanism: Tranquility is deliberately placed inside a medium named by a root of turning. The ship-stabilizer branch makes it an active steering or damping capacity, not merely a pleasant feeling.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its proper station supplies the deliberate placement of tranquility inside the heart.
A ship's stabilizing control literally quiets oscillation and supplies the steering image for tranquility.
Turning a thing from face to face makes the heart a reversal-prone medium whose direction can be stabilized.

changed_reading.before: God gives believers a calm feeling.
changed_reading.after: God installs a steering and damping capacity inside reversal-prone hearts so that trust can hold a direction.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same root appears as believers, faith, and their faith around an explicit increase. Tranquility supplies security to already trusting hearts, and that secured trust becomes the substrate for further trust.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled confidence recur across believer and faith forms, supplying both the input and output of the increase.
Heart-settling assent supplies the cognitive trust that tranquility amplifies rather than replacing.
Growth entering a thing supplies the gain operation by which existing faith yields added faith.

changed_reading.before: Believers receive a larger quantity of propositional belief.
changed_reading.after: Received security lets already-present trust recursively generate a more settled capacity to trust.

baseline_models.mechanism: The force-ownership clause immediately follows the heart operation. This permits tranquility to be carried as a coordinated inner deployment among divine forces, while the vertical pair of heavens and earth prevents 'force' from being restricted to visible armies.

activation_trace.role: The cessation of disruptive motion supplies tranquility's active effect within the heart.
A mutually supporting gathered force supplies the category into which the adjacent inner operation may be recruited.
What rises above and overshadows supplies the upper field of an all-scale deployment.
The lower field opposite heaven completes the span from invisible height to embodied ground.

changed_reading.before: The armies clause is a separate reassurance about external divine power.
changed_reading.after: The heart-deposited tranquility can itself be read as an active inner regiment within a force field extending through heaven and earth.

baseline_models.mechanism: The packet offers two control images: a ship made steady and a bridle that checks running. Placed around a gathered force and closed by knowledge, they make tranquility the governance of power rather than power's opposite.

activation_trace.role: The ship control that arrests oscillation supplies a steering function for the inner state.
The gathered supporting force supplies the power that must be coordinated rather than merely maximized.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the information by which force can be selectively governed.
A bridle that checks an animal's running supplies the governing restraint attached to divine wisdom.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility and military force form a contrast between passivity and action.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility is a command-and-control capacity that keeps real power informed, directed, and restrained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opening and powerful aid are announced before the focus discloses an operation inside hearts. Read together, victory can begin as an unblocking and strengthening of the community's inner capacity before it appears as an external result.

activation_trace.role: An obstruction opening into a wider entrance supplies the result-image that the heart operation can begin internally.
Aid that supports and makes manifest supplies the outward efficacy of inward stabilization.
Strengthening supplies the transition from settled hearts to effective collective capacity.
Motion ceasing supplies the inward unblocking from reactive agitation.

structural_cues: 48:1-3 announce opening and aid immediately before 48:4 explains descent into hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the outward result before the inward operation; I infer a result-to-mechanism relation, while the live alternative is that these are parallel gifts with no causal ordering.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility consoles believers after an already accomplished victory.
changed_reading.after: The victory may begin as an inward opening: agitation is cleared and the community becomes capable of receiving and carrying aid.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's ownership of forces is repeated after paired beneficial and destructive outcomes. That repetition frames tranquility not as an isolated mood but as one operative mode within a regime that can deliver rescue, return defeat, and restrain corruption.

activation_trace.role: Attaining good and escaping harm supplies the beneficial destination of the force frame.
A returning circle of defeat supplies the adverse outcome enclosed by the same sovereignty frame.
The repeated gathered force makes the focus's inner deployment part of a wider coordinated field.
Restraint that prevents corruption supplies the governing mode of the repeated force clause.

structural_cues: 48:4 and 48:7 repeat divine ownership of the forces around the contrasting destinations in 48:5-6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated clause bracketing opposite outcomes; I infer that the repetition classifies the intervening operations, while it may instead be a general sovereignty refrain.

changed_reading.before: The forces clause is a generic aside after the gift of tranquility.
changed_reading.after: The repeated force frame presents tranquility as an active deployment within a governed system of rescue, reversal, and judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge can be kept whole or unraveled, and its later enactment joins pledge, known hearts, descending tranquility, and near opening. Faith's increase therefore has a social reading: tranquility holds a pledged body together under pressure so its members can act as mutually reliable trust-bearers.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience supplies the concrete social bond whose stability is at stake.
A preserved covenant that secures its holder supplies the durable trust structure joining the participants.
Unraveling something after it was made firm supplies the failure mode that tranquility counters.
The repeated tranquility acts like a stabilizer on the pledged group at the moment of collective commitment.
The near opening supplies the collective consequence of a pledge held steady rather than unraveled.

structural_cues: 48:10 defines pledge, breach, and fulfillment; 48:18 repeats pledge, hearts, descent of tranquility, and then near opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the pledge's failure mode and later places tranquility at its enactment; I infer a cohesion arrow from tranquility to covenantal reliability, while personal reassurance remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Faith increases privately inside separate individuals.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility increases faith as collective reliability: it keeps a pledged body from unraveling and makes shared action possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech can remain on the tongue while absent from the heart, and destructive expectation can be made attractive inside hearts. The heart is therefore a contested, revisable surface; descending tranquility is a counter-formation that settles genuine trust beneath verbal display and alluring projection.

activation_trace.role: The speech organ supplies an external verbal layer that can diverge from the heart.
Making something appear attractive supplies the rival process by which a destructive expectation occupies hearts.
An expectation whose outcome cannot be trusted supplies the unstable content opposed to faith's security.
Return and heart occur through one turning root, making reversal both the feared outcome and the inner medium.
Settling after movement supplies a durable counter-process to verbal display and decorated suspicion.

structural_cues: 48:11 contrasts tongues with hearts, and 48:12 immediately shows a harmful expectation beautified inside hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two rival ways hearts are occupied; I infer that tranquility displaces or outlasts false decoration, while the text may only contrast different populations rather than narrate replacement.

changed_reading.before: The heart is a passive container into which calm is poured.
changed_reading.after: The heart is a contested and reversible surface, and tranquility forms trust there against empty speech and attractive misexpectation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hands are withheld even after victory is available, because unrecognized believers are mixed into the field and could be trampled, producing an unseen moral stain. Knowledge discriminates hidden persons; wisdom restrains force until distinction is possible. This makes tranquility an inner capacity for informed non-action under conditions of power.

activation_trace.role: Withholding and prevention supply the first explicit form taken by effective power.
Hands as embodied strength supply the bilateral force that is actively restrained.
Victory by dominance establishes that withholding is governed choice rather than incapacity.
Severe pressure underfoot supplies the collateral mechanism that undifferentiated force would cause.
A stain acquired through evil supplies the hidden moral consequence of blind action.
Separating and distinguishing mixed things supplies the condition under which force could be safely retargeted.
Knowledge of concealed identities supplies the targeting information unavailable to the acting community.
The bridle image supplies the focus's inner analogue for checking force after capability is present.

structural_cues: 48:20 and 48:24 repeat the withholding of hands; 48:25 explains hidden intermixture and unintended harm, echoing 48:4's knowing-wise close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies available victory, withheld hands, concealed persons, and the cost of trampling; I infer that tranquility internalizes this discriminating restraint, while the alternative is purely external providential prevention.

changed_reading.before: Ownership of armies promises the maximum application of superior force.
changed_reading.after: Knowing wisdom routes power through restraint: tranquility enables the faithful to refrain when victory is available but the human field cannot yet be cleanly distinguished.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heated defensive pride and agitated unreason are placed in one set of hearts; tranquility is then sent upon the other side and followed by adherence to a protective word. The sequence makes sakina a thermal and behavioral regulator that converts provocation into durable restraint.

activation_trace.role: Heat and heating supply the thermal intensity installed in the opposing hearts.
Proud defensive anger supplies the social behavior generated by that heat.
Agitated temperament lacking forbearance supplies the unstable motion opposed by tranquility.
The repeated tranquility literally removes disruptive motion and acts as the counter-state to heated agitation.
Persistent attachment supplies the durable behavior produced after the inner settling.
Protection that repels harm supplies the function of the word to which the believers are held.

structural_cues: 48:26 places heated zeal in hearts, then contrasts it with the descent of tranquility and immediate adherence to the protective word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat, agitation, settling, and adherence in sequence; I infer a cooling-and-binding arrow, while the live alternative is reassurance that accompanies rather than causes restraint.

changed_reading.after: Sakina is a regulator that cools status-defensive heat and binds the community to protective speech and conduct under provocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A true vision promises secure entry without fear, yet unknown knowledge places a near opening before its fulfillment. Faith's increase can therefore be temporal endurance: tranquility lets trust survive an altered itinerary without treating delay as falsification.

activation_trace.role: A promise verified in action supplies the trustworthy endpoint despite delay.
A dream vision supplies the anticipated itinerary whose timing remains incomplete.
Entry into an interior supplies the promised arrival toward which trust must travel.
Secure confidence supplies the embodied condition of the eventual entry.
Expected harm supplies the state explicitly absent at arrival but live during deferral.
Knowledge disclosed to one knower and withheld from others supplies the reason the route can differ from expectation.
An opening that begins what follows supplies the interim event before final entry.
Growth supplies the increased capacity of trust to endure a deferred and rerouted fulfillment.

structural_cues: 48:27 holds truthful vision, eventual secure entry, present ignorance, and an intervening near opening in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a true endpoint and a rerouted timetable; I infer that tranquility sustains trust across the gap, while the alternative is that the focus's increase is unrelated to this later delay.

changed_reading.before: More faith means greater certainty that the expected event will happen immediately as imagined.
changed_reading.after: Increased faith is the capacity to remain secure when a true promise is fulfilled through an unknown sequence rather than the expected timetable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing plant does not grow by isolated addition: it sends out shoots, the shoots support it, the whole thickens, and it stands. That sequence turns 'faith with their faith' into reciprocal community growth in which stabilized members become supports that increase one another's stability.

activation_trace.role: Cultivated growth supplies the living process that expands rather than merely accumulates.
Bringing something out from concealment supplies the emergence of latent communal capacity.
New shoots around the original plant supply differentiated members produced by the shared root.
Plants strengthening through mutual support supplies the reciprocal arrow from members back to the whole.
A body thickening after thinness supplies the increased resilience produced by mutual support.
Rising and settling firmly on a support supplies the stable collective posture reached by growth.
Increase and growth anchor the plant sequence back in the focus's explicit purpose.
Heart-settling trust supplies the shared living substance that members amplify in one another.

structural_cues: 48:29 ends the surah with a sequential growth mechanism whose mutual strengthening unfolds the focus's 'increase in faith with their faith.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal plant growth and the focus supplies self-related increase; I map the plant's support loop onto communal faith, while the live alternative is that the plant image describes public strength without explaining 48:4's increase.

changed_reading.before: Each believer privately receives an additive increment of faith.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility enables ecological growth: newly stabilized members support the body that produced them, so faith increases through reciprocal reinforcement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This systems-style reading is surprising because 'feedback loop' is a reader-supplied abstraction, but it remains anchored in faith increasing with faith, the turning heart, the returning circle of defeat, and beautified expectation. Render it as a structural analogy, not as a claim that the ayah states a technical theory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ in a ق ل ب medium

activation_trace.role: Settled security recurring as believer and faith supplies the same substance on both sides of the positive loop.
Growth entering the existing state supplies the loop's amplifying operation.
Rotation and return supply the negative mirror in which a destructive state comes back upon its holders.
Making a bad expectation attractive supplies a reinforcement mechanism for the rival loop.
Turning and returning supply the shared reversible medium in which either loop can take hold.

changed_reading.before: The ayah describes a one-way increase in faith.
changed_reading.after: Sakina may seed a self-reinforcing trust loop, structurally opposed to the self-returning loop of decorated destructive expectation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ز ي د to ز و د mapping and a guest-provision branch of ن ز ل. Both are packet-authorized but form-distant. It remains anchored in أَنزَلَ and يَزْدَادُوا and is sharpened by later secure entry; downstream prose should mark it as a wordplay-like overlay, not the primary lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَنزَلَ ... لِيَزْدَادُوا combined with the split ز ي د inventory

activation_trace.role: Prepared hospitality for one who arrives supplies the image of tranquility as provision delivered to travelers.
The split mapping's carried provisions for transition recasts added faith as what sustains passage.
Entry into the sanctuary supplies the delayed arrival toward which the provision is carried.
Secure confidence at entry supplies the condition preserved through the journey.

changed_reading.before: Faith is simply made quantitatively larger.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility may be received as hospitality for the road, while added faith becomes provision carried through deferred passage toward secure arrival.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This semiotic reading is surprising because it activates the non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping. The packet nevertheless supplies visible signs and marks elsewhere, so the reading remains anchored in the focus's heavens and forces. Render it only as a possible overlay in which signs act upon perception, never as a replacement for 'heavens.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ with the packet's split س م و inventory

activation_trace.role: A visible mark from which a condition is inferred supplies a legible dimension to the forces of the heavens.
An overt sign for believers supplies a context in which perception itself can redirect trust.
A mark read by an observer supplies an outward trace of inward formation.
A remaining trace that indicates what occurred supplies the durable evidence through which the inner becomes legible.

changed_reading.before: The forces of heaven and earth are only beings or material powers.
changed_reading.after: Some forces may operate as legible signs and traces whose recognition stabilizes perception and increases trust.

strongest_changes: Sakina becomes active regulation inside a turning heart rather than generic calm.
The pledge sequence makes increased faith a collective cohesion mechanism.
Withheld hands and concealed believers make knowing wisdom the discriminating restraint of available force.
The heat-versus-sakina contrast makes tranquility a regulator that converts provocation into protective adherence.
The final plant sequence makes faith's increase reciprocal and ecological rather than privately additive.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting mechanisms: tranquility as inner regiment, as steering and restraint over force, as covenantal cohesion, as temporal endurance, and as reciprocal growth. Split mappings also preserve materially strange but packet-grounded readings of faith as travel provision and heavenly forces as legible marks.
remaining_uncertainties: The adjacency of sakina and divine forces permits but does not prove that sakina is itself one of those forces.
The control-system and feedback language is a reader abstraction over branch and sequence evidence.
The travel-provision and sign-field readings depend on non-dominant mapped roots and should remain explicitly exploratory.
Sakina may be the cause of disciplined restraint, its accompaniment, or both; the context does not fully settle the arrow.
